name: Remix Shivraj Madan - Portfolio
description:
Make the following final improvements before I deploy this website to GitHub Pages:

1. Keep the current professional design exactly as it is.
2. Make sure my LinkedIn button points to:
https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivrajmadan

3. Make sure every LinkedIn button/link on the entire website points to:
https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivrajmadan

4. Do NOT add Instagram.

5. Keep the profile photo placeholder, because I will add my real photo manually later.

6. Make sure the project is a completely static website that can be hosted on GitHub Pages for FREE.

7. Remove any unnecessary backend, API, database, authentication, npm, or paid service requirements.

8. Make sure the final project contains:
index.html
style.css
script.js
robots.txt
sitemap.xml
images/

9. Make sure robots.txt and sitemap.xml are ready for GitHub Pages.

10. Make sure the website has valid Person JSON-LD structured data with:
Name: Shivraj Madan
Location: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, India
LinkedIn:
https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivrajmadan

11. Do not invent any achievements, certifications, jobs, awards, companies, followers, or statistics.

12. Keep the website fast, professional, mobile responsive and SEO-friendly.

After making these changes, show me the final project files and confirm that it is ready for GitHub Pages deployment.
